text:
jessica (AE): Heads up — Meridian Labs (execs + CISO) just sent a final checklist. They want a formal runbook for Dedicated deployment, target SLOs, and committed throughput numbers by EOD tomorrow. They also pushed back on pricing floor; asking for a 6–9 month committed discount. @omar can you triage ops runbook?
omar (Solutions Eng): On it. Can you forward the CISO email? Need to scope the runbook sections: network, KMS, onboarding, failover, contact list.
jessica (AE): Forwarded. Key asks: VPC peering diagram, KMS BYOK steps, expected latency at 256-token average, and canary rollback steps. Their procurement also wants a billing cadence note.
liam (Runtime Eng): For latency numbers we can provide 95th p90/p95 at three load points. I need the model + batch profile though. Which model are they pinning?
jessica (AE): They want Redwood-7B-q2 quantized (recommended) for initial pilot. Target: 500 reqs/s burst to 2k/s sustained after week 2. Can you draft perf numbers? :eyes:
omar (Solutions Eng): I'll draft runbook skeleton. Proposed sections: 1) Preflight (accounts, allowlist) 2) Network & Peering (diagram + CIDR) 3) KMS BYOK flow 4) Deploy steps (dedicated pool, model pinning) 5) Canary & rollback 6) Escalation contact list + SLAs 7) Post-mortem template.
tanya (Security): I need to review KMS BYOK text and the audit log retention. Also they asked about HSM attestation — we currently offer KMS integration but not attestation reports by default. We can offer SOC2 logs + KMS key lifecycle documentation. Is that acceptable to them?
jessica (AE): CISO explicitly asked for attestation or a third-party attestation timeline. They said it's a blocker for procurement. Mark — any flexibility on offering an attestation letter or timeline?
mark (VP Sales): We can't promise a new attestation in the short term. Offer a mitigated path: 1) formalized runbook + KMS integration diagrams 2) signed statement of current controls + SOC2 report 3) 3–6 month roadmap for attestation with periodic checkpoints. If they need hard attestation before contract, escalate to legal procurement.
jessica (AE): Understood. I'll propose that. Also pricing: they're asking for a 6–9 month committed discount below standard floor. We have reserved capacity SKUs — omar, can you confirm earliest spin-up + pricing for a 3-month reserved with burst credits?
omar (Solutions Eng): Earliest spin-up: 7 business days for dedicated pool in us-west (depends on quota). Pricing for 3mo reserved with burst: draft number is $X/month (will DM exact). If they want a deeper discount we need exec approval.
liam (Runtime Eng): Quick note on rollback steps — suggest we include the automated fallback policy to hosted variants plus config snippet:
```
# example fallback policy
policy:
  priority: [redwood-7B-q2, redwood-7B-q1-hosted]
  timeout_ms: 3000
  max_retries: 2
```
This prevents downtime if dedicated pool degrades.
ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket RB-4821 for Meridian Labs Dedicated onboarding (assignee: omar).
jessica (AE): Thanks — Omar, can you own the runbook draft and post by 11:00 AM PST tomorrow? Tanya please flag any security blockers inline. Mark I need a one-liner for procurement about attestation to include in the reply.
omar (Solutions Eng): Owning it. I'll post a draft in this thread + attach diagram links.
tanya (Security): I'll review ASAP. Two quick flags: (1) BYOK key escrow — they need clarity on rotation; (2) Network ACLs — we need their egress constraints to validate failover.
mark (VP Sales): One-liner for procurement: "Redwood will provide SOC2 reports, a signed controls attestation, and a documented timeline for HSM attestation; production attestation delivery subject to legal review." Use that and I'll back it up in the exec bridge if needed.
jessica (AE): Good — I'll send reply with that language. Meeting? Meridian requested a CISO -> VP bridge this week. Can we do Fri 9am PT?
omar (Solutions Eng): Fri 9am PT works for me. Liam/Tanya?
liam (Runtime Eng): I can do Fri 9am.
tanya (Security): I can do Fri 9am.
jessica (AE): Scheduler sent to Meridian + internal invite to this group. Action items summary: 1) Omar — runbook draft by 11:00 AM PST tomorrow (RB-4821) 2) Liam — latency/perf numbers for Redwood-7B-q2 by EOD tomorrow 3) Tanya — security review & escalations inline 4) Mark — exec note for procurement (done) 5) Jessica — reply to CISO + schedule bridge.
mark (VP Sales): If procurement pushes hard on price floor, we'll escalate to the CEO for one-off approval. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
jessica (AE): Thanks all, will update thread with draft and tracker link.
